properties.description: Pins add_inference's `held_as` over MCP. A model with two idealizations assumed with held_as model raises no reasoning_not_as_stated gap, loop_status has no NOT AS STATED line and counts reasoning.assumptions_held_on_purpose 2 with both ids, and reasoning_report lists each assumption with held_as model and "held on purpose" while the claim reads conditional. A chosen principle (held_as principle) reads the same. An assumption with nothing said reads as before (one gap, undischarged_assumptions 1, no new field) and the gap names held_as; saying supposition reads the same; saying model on a revise moves it. held_as is refused on a statement of kind hypothesis, and with nothing in `assumed`.
